title: Prohibition from political activity.
bodyText: The members of the ethics commission and its staff shall not take an active part in political management or in political campaigns during the term of office or employment.
bodyHtml: [§84-35.5]  Prohibition from political activity.  The members of the ethics commission and its staff shall not take an active part in political management or in political campaigns during the term of office or employment. [L 1979, c 91, §10]
